info.name: Insightt Tasks — Mark-as-Done Concurrency Demo
info.description:
Demo collection for the video: creates a task via REST, then fires the `markTaskDone` GraphQL mutation twice against the same task so you can show one request winning (status DONE) and the other getting a 409 ALREADY_DONE GraphQL error.

Setup before recording:
1. Make sure the backend is running (`npm run dev:backend`).
2. Get a Cognito ID token: log in on the mobile app, then temporarily add `console.log(session.idToken)` inside `signIn()` in `mobile/src/auth/cognito.ts` (or `restoreSession`), copy it from the Metro log, and remove the line afterwards. Paste that token into this collection's `idToken` variable (bottom of the Variables tab, or click the collection → Variables).
3. Run "1. Create Task" once — it saves the new task's id into the `taskId` variable automatically.
4. Open "2. Mark Task Done — Attempt A" and "3. Mark Task Done — Attempt B" in two separate tabs and click Send on both back-to-back (as close together as you can). Whichever the server processes first returns `status: DONE`; the other returns a GraphQL error with `extensions.code: ALREADY_DONE`.

Note: Postman can't fire two requests in the exact same tick the way `Promise.all()` does, so this is a visual demo of the guard, not a rigorous concurrency test — that's what `backend/tests/integration/markAsDone.test.ts` (the "handles two concurrent requests safely" test) is for. Feel free to show that test passing in the video as the real proof.
